---
title: "Teaching & Mentoring"
---

Teaching, mentoring, and training are important parts of my academic work. I have trained students and researchers in experimental design, instrument operation, safe laboratory practices, rheological and spectroscopic measurements, data analysis, troubleshooting, and technical communication.

## Teaching interests

- Chemical engineering fundamentals
- Soft matter and complex fluids
- Polymer science and engineering
- Rheology and transport phenomena
- Materials characterization
- Experimental design and data analysis
- Laboratory courses involving polymers, fluids, spectroscopy, and thermal/mechanical analysis

## Mentoring approach

My mentoring emphasizes scientific rigor, independence, clear documentation, safe experimental practice, and thoughtful interpretation of data. I encourage students to connect experimental observations with physical mechanisms and to communicate results clearly for both specialized and interdisciplinary audiences.

## Student training areas

- Rheometer operation and method development
- Thermal analysis using DSC and TGA
- Dynamic mechanical analysis
- Raman and FTIR spectroscopy
- Mechanical testing and materials processing
- Experimental planning, troubleshooting, and reproducible data analysis
